easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
